sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm on my way to the airport with a suitcase.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It's heavy, and I don't want to carry it upstairs.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I follow a sign to the station from the street.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, is this the way to the airport trains?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, they're on the upper">upper

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I've got my ticket, so can I go straight up?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, have your ticket ready when you get to the gate.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I can see the gate at the top of the stairs.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's it. Keep your ticket out till you're through.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I'll take the escalator and go up that way.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: At the bottom, I see a sign across the escalator.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It's out of order. Is there another way up?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, we've got a lift as well.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Oh, good. I don't see one from here.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: If you've got heavy bags, there's a lift just inside the car park.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, where's the lift again?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Just inside the car park.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: How do I get to the car park from here?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Go through that short tunnel and turn right.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks. I'll take the lift from there.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I look through the tunnel from where we're standing.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Oh, I can see the sign for the lift now.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yep, that's it. Press two for the station.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Does it open right by the ticket gate?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, it opens on the same level as the gate.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The doors on the other side will open upstairs.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Good, I can roll my bag straight out that way.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Which way do I turn when I get out?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The gate's on your left, just past the map.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, that'll save me from carrying this bag upstairs.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I roll my bag through the gate and catch my train.
